works.title: Political Dog-Whistle Allegory Novel
works.description: A dark political allegory about a mainstream political party that cynically weaponizes racist, homophobic, and anti-immigrant dog whistles to energize voters without expecting to enact the policies. When a populist demagogue rises and takes the propaganda literally, implementing destructive policies the party never intended, the narrative explores how institutional deception spawns its own authoritarian consequences.
works.quote: The scary part is that the book which now I feel almost needs to be written is happening in real life today in the United States.
